<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Architecture.ArchitectureValidator.Execute(System.String[],System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Executes repository validation or an explicitly requested documentation maintenance operation.
    </summary>
    <param name="arguments">
    The optional repository path, configuration, XML maintenance flag, explicit SDK, evaluated graph output,
    and Wiki inventories with explicitly selected runtime and editor script reference assemblies.
    --wiki-target limits product compilation to that explicit target; shared Wiki checks remain complete.
    --wiki-contracts-only checks signatures and examples; repository structure and links require separate documentation evidence.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels owned SDK evaluation processes and drains them before returning.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Zero when validation succeeds, or one when any invariant is violated.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    An option is unknown or more than one repository path is supplied.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.DirectoryNotFoundException">
    The requested path is not inside an engine checkout.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    The caller cancels evaluated SDK project inspection.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.InvalidDataException">
    A selected Wiki script reference is not the declared logical API assembly.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Architecture.DocumentationCommand.GetProjectDocuments(System.String)">
    <summary>
    Maps existing canonical pages and their included or same-name directory fragments to actual repository projects.
    Missing project pages remain the responsibility of the required documentation structure check.
    </summary>
    <param name="root">
    The absolute repository root containing docs and the existing source project inventory.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Repository-relative Markdown paths mapped to repository-relative project paths, without SDK evaluation.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.InvalidDataException">
    Project pages are ambiguous, or an inclusion is absent, repeats or cycles.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    A documentation path escapes its owner, follows a link or cannot be read.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    The root is invalid or repository projects have duplicate names.
    </exception>
</member>

    <summary>
    Indexes Markdown or retrieves search excerpts, complete sections and exact documented symbols.
    </summary>
    <param name="arguments">
    The index, search, read or symbol operation followed by engine-root, query, project, page, section, id,
    limit, offset and format options. Format is text or json; pages are relative to the repository root.
    Offset resumes an explicitly partial section without discarding intervening Markdown.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels index preparation before publication while retaining the last complete index.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Zero after emitting a valid result, including explicit empty search results or ambiguity candidates.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    An operation, option, project, section or symbol is absent, ambiguous as an input, or invalid.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    A page is missing, a path escapes its owner, an inclusion is invalid or documentation changes during indexing.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    The caller cancels indexing or ownership acquisition.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Architecture.DocumentationExamples.ExecuteAsync(System.String[],System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Validates complete example groups in a prepared snapshot using one evaluated SDK graph.
    </summary>
    <param name="arguments">
    Required engine-root, cache-root, snapshot, dotnet and output options; optional repeated page identities,
    configuration, target, artifacts-path, sdk-snapshot, runtime-reference and editor-reference. References must already exist.
    A supplied resolved SDK snapshot must match the requested properties and contain every selected example owner.
    Its caller maintains the stable execution boundary and verifies closing inputs; the graph alone does not certify freshness.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels reading, SDK inspection or compilation before atomic report publication.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Zero when every selected example group compiles; one for failed compilation, missing prerequisites,
    missing explicit contexts or empty required example discovery. The report preserves each group's status.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    Options are missing, duplicated or unknown, or a requested page does not exist.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    Snapshot integrity, repository inventory or report publication fails.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    Validation was canceled; no completed report replaces the previous result.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Architecture.DocumentationReferences.ExportApi(System.String[],System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Exports selected CLR source contracts using the existing evaluated API extractor, independently of Wiki pages.
    This operation does not certify script projection, behavioral prose, examples or product execution.
    </summary>
    <param name="arguments">
    Required engine-root, dotnet, output and one or more project options; optional configuration and target.
    Project paths are relative to the engine root and must occur in its actual source inventory.
    The selected SDK and prepared references supply compilation facts; no product build is requested.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels evaluated capture and extraction before atomic publication.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Zero after publishing complete facts for every selected project, including explicit empty public surfaces.
    Source API certification remains separate from this extraction result.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    Required options are absent, an option is duplicated or unsupported, or a project is not an actual owner.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    Inputs are unavailable, escape ownership, or cannot be published.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.InvalidDataException">
    A selected compilation or public signature is unavailable or unresolved.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    The caller cancels capture, extraction or publication.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Architecture.DocumentationReferences.ValidateApiAsync(System.String[],System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Compares explicitly selected reference manifests with one freshly evaluated source compilation batch.
    Declaration, XML, constant and inheritance changes are checked without building products or parsing Markdown.
    </summary>
    <param name="arguments">
    Required engine-root, dotnet, output and repeated reference options. All references must select the same
    source-clr configuration and target; their actual projects determine the batch, including empty public surfaces.
    An explicit cache-root and snapshot pair reads logical reference paths from that protected generation.
    Otherwise reference paths select local files. An optional artifacts-path selects the prepared compile output owner.
    An optional sdk-snapshot supplies one previously resolved SDK graph with matching properties and selected owners.
    The caller owns its stable execution boundary and closing input checks; a supplied graph is not independent freshness evidence.
    Repeated project options restrict comparison to declared owners;
    an absent owner is an error. Snapshot provenance is reported separately from source compatibility.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels capture or comparison before replacing the report.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Zero when the selected reference facts match, or one with explicit differences. This bounded result does not
    certify authored prose, script projections, examples, other targets or publication provenance.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    Options, reference selection or evaluated context are missing, duplicated or unsupported.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.InvalidDataException">
    Required discovery is empty, identities repeat, reference inputs change, or source compilation is unavailable.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    A selected input is absent, escapes its declared source owner, or report publication fails.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    The caller cancels before a complete comparison report is published.
    </exception>
</member>

    <summary>
    Writes a deterministic project inventory without claiming evaluated API surfaces or source verification.
    </summary>
    <param name="arguments">
    Explicit engine-root and output options. Output is a derived reference artifact, not a project selection table.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels source enumeration before atomic output publication.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Zero after publishing the current source-project inventory.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    An option is missing, duplicated or unsupported.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    A source path escapes the engine boundary or the destination cannot be published.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.InvalidDataException">
    Required source discovery is empty or project identities are ambiguous.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    The caller cancels before publication.
    </exception>
</member>
